title: Exact ordinal and intact row inventories leave only four layouts under balanced two-row moves
statement: A fixed public conditional sampler simultaneously preserves every original P-line word multiset, each positional EVA-basic length, and word marginals at exact original ordinal k within same-page equal-width row pairs. Pairs are selected only from invariant row inventories. Integer dynamic programming samples all feasible row-pair assignments exactly uniformly, including two-word swaps and longer balanced cycles; brute-force fixtures verify counts and ranked assignments. In ZL/IT evaluation,260/263 fixed row pairs contain only one active pair each, two conditional layouts and8potentially movable adjacent pairs. Thus both fail the frozen >=30movable-pair and >=100layout gates; no confirmatory p-value is reported. A separately declared post-review census checks ALL1706/1729same-page equal-width row pairs: only two active pairs per edition, affecting16of4796/4740adjacent pairs. Exact breadth-first closure over ALL balanced two-row moves is complete and contains only4layouts in each edition,8changing word positions and16affected adjacent pairs. A uniform exact-tail probability on4states cannot be smaller than0.25, so this component cannot support alpha0.01. The primary model and generator controls are all mobility-deficient. This is limited testability under balanced two-row moves, not evidence for or against the residual association. It does not exclude additional irreducible moves requiring three or more rows at once. Only previously used public practice pages were examined; PR673 and its unpublished hidden fact draft are unchanged.
check: Do not publish an ESTABLISHED or REFUTED fact from this inert/sparse control, and do not reinterpret descriptive Monte Carlo tails as valid primary results after its frozen mobility gates fail. Keep row-pair and two-row-component limitations explicit. Further work would need a separately specified exact or provably calibrated sampler for irreducible simultaneous trades among three or more rows, retaining per-row word inventories, exact k word marginals and positional lengths, with support and mobility checked before significance. Hidden-page evaluation remains gated on reviewed metric code; retain the original PR673 fact unchanged.

plan.question: Can exact ordinal/length word marginals and each original line word multiset be preserved simultaneously while testing edge association?
plan.sample: Same34 public practice evaluation pages, ZL and IT; previously used pages.
plan.pairing: Within each page and original token-count width n, greedily pair unused P rows by decreasing overlap of their certain-word multisets; tie by original row order. Pairing reads only invariant row inventories, never word order or edge statistics.
plan.conditioning: In each fixed row pair, keep the unordered pair of words at every original index k fixed. Only columns with two certain nonempty words of equal EVA-basic length may change. Keep the word multiset of each original row exactly fixed. Other rows and columns remain frozen.
plan.sampler: Dynamic programming counts every feasible assignment to row A under its fixed multiset; row B gets the other word at each column. Sample exactly uniformly using integer completion counts. Disjoint row-pair choices are independent; no MCMC or mixing assumption. Two-word exchanges and longer balanced cycles both allowed.
plan.scope: A conditional orbit for fixed row pairs, not the entire fiber of all possible multi-row trades. Row-pair column marginals are stronger constraints than page-wide ordinal marginals.
plan.metric: Unchanged edge_length_cmi in certain literal adjacent P words; gaps and line boundaries stay barriers.
plan.decision: Support only if both editions have >=30 potentially movable adjacent pairs, >=100 distinct conditional layouts, a nonconstant null, and one-sided plus-one p<=.01. Otherwise report insufficient or invariant, never relax constraints after results.
plan.cost_limit: At most250000 dynamic-programming states per row pair; exceeding it makes this diagnostic undefined rather than changing the sampler.
plan.limits: Exact transcription index k and token-count width n; no physical x coordinates or spacing. One seed per generator. A non-rejection is not proof that positions explain the association.

evidence.selfcheck: Exact counts, all ranked assignments and movable columns match brute-force enumeration: rectangle, three-cycle, repeated-word six-state case, unequal-length inert case.

plan.phase: Post-review feasibility census, specified after the fixed-pair primary result was seen.
plan.scope: All unordered P-row pairs within same public page and exact token count, ZL and IT evaluation only.
plan.report: Exact feasible assignments and union of affected positions at the observed layout. No new p-value. Do not multiply overlapping pair supports or claim this exhausts trades among three or more rows.

plan.phase: Post-review feasibility extension after the all-pair census, not a new significance test.
plan.moves: All exact balanced two-row assignments within same public page and original width, equal per-position lengths, fixed word multiset in each row and fixed unordered column word pairs for each move.
plan.report: BFS enumerates the entire reachable component or explicitly reports truncation. Only ZL/IT manuscript practice evaluation. Does not cover irreducible trades involving three or more rows simultaneously. No confirmatory p-value.

zl.interpretation: Feasibility only; too little support for alpha.01 when fewer than100 states. No claim about multi-row irreducible cycles.

it.interpretation: Feasibility only; too little support for alpha.01 when fewer than100 states. No claim about multi-row irreducible cycles.
